phases.name: Foundation — Java Version Upgrade
phases.description: Upgrade Java 8 to Java 17 LTS. This is a blocker for all subsequent tasks since Spring Boot 3.x requires Java 17+.

phases.name: Framework — Spring Boot 3.x Upgrade
phases.description: Upgrade Spring Boot 2.7.18 to 3.2.x, which brings Spring Framework 6.x transitively and requires javax → jakarta namespace migration.

phases.name: Azure Migration — Messaging
phases.description: Migrate from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus for fully managed messaging on Azure.

phases.name: Security — Credential Management
phases.description: Remove hardcoded credentials and migrate to Azure Key Vault or Managed Identity for passwordless connections.

phases.name: Containerization — Dockerfile Update
phases.description: Update Dockerfile base images to match the upgraded Java version and follow container best practices.

tasks.title: Upgrade Java 8 → Java 17 LTS
tasks.description: Upgrade from Java 8 to Java 17 LTS. Update pom.xml properties (java.version, maven.compiler.source, maven.compiler.target) from 8 to 17. This is a blocker for Spring Boot 3.x which requires Java 17+.
changes: Update <java.version>8</java.version> → <java.version>17</java.version>
Update <maven.compiler.source>8</maven.compiler.source> → <maven.compiler.source>17</maven.compiler.source>
Update <maven.compiler.target>8</maven.compiler.target> → <maven.compiler.target>17</maven.compiler.target>
Review code for removed/deprecated Java APIs (no issues expected for this small codebase)
tasks.successCriteria: Project compiles successfully with Java 17. All existing tests pass.

tasks.title: Upgrade Spring Boot 2.7.18 → Spring Boot 3.2.x
tasks.description: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 3.2.x. This also resolves the Spring Framework 5.x → 6.x upgrade transitively. Requires javax → jakarta namespace migration for any Jakarta EE APIs used.
changes: Update spring-boot-starter-parent version from 2.7.18 to 3.2.x in pom.xml
Migrate javax.* imports to jakarta.* if present in source files
Update any deprecated Spring Boot 2.x APIs to 3.x equivalents
Verify spring-boot-starter-amqp compatibility with Spring Boot 3.x
Update spring-boot-maven-plugin configuration if needed
Run full test suite to validate the upgrade
tasks.successCriteria: Project compiles and all tests pass with Spring Boot 3.2.x. Application starts successfully.

tasks.title: Migrate RabbitMQ → Azure Service Bus
tasks.description: Replace RabbitMQ with Azure Service Bus for managed messaging on Azure. Replace spring-boot-starter-amqp with Spring Cloud Azure Service Bus integration. Migrate 3 queues: order.created, inventory.alert, approval.pending.
changes: Replace spring-boot-starter-amqp dependency with spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus-jms in pom.xml
Add Spring Cloud Azure BOM for dependency management
Rewrite OrderMessageListener.java: replace @RabbitListener with @JmsListener (or Service Bus SDK annotations)
Update application.yml: remove spring.rabbitmq.* config, add spring.cloud.azure.servicebus.* config
Map RabbitMQ queues to Azure Service Bus queues: order.created, inventory.alert, approval.pending
Add Azure Service Bus connection configuration (namespace, connection-string placeholder)
tasks.successCriteria: Application compiles with Azure Service Bus dependencies. Message listener annotations updated. Configuration points to Azure Service Bus.

tasks.title: Remove Hardcoded Credentials → Azure Key Vault / Managed Identity

target.to: Azure Key Vault or Azure Managed Identity (passwordless)

tasks.description: Remove hardcoded RabbitMQ credentials (username: guest, password: guest) from application.yml line 13. If Service Bus migration is complete, configure passwordless connection via Azure Managed Identity. Otherwise, externalize secrets to Azure Key Vault.
changes: Remove hardcoded spring.rabbitmq.username and spring.rabbitmq.password from application.yml
Add spring-cloud-azure-starter-keyvault-secrets dependency to pom.xml (if using Key Vault)
Configure Azure Managed Identity for passwordless Service Bus connection
Add environment variable references for any remaining secrets
Ensure no credentials are committed in source code
tasks.successCriteria: No hardcoded credentials in application.yml. Secrets managed via Azure Key Vault or Managed Identity.

tasks.title: Update Dockerfile Base Images for Java 17
tasks.description: Update Dockerfile FROM statements to use Java 17 base images. Update the build stage from maven:3.8-openjdk-8 to maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17 and the runtime stage from eclipse-temurin:8-jre to eclipse-temurin:17-jre.
changes: Update build stage: FROM maven:3.8-openjdk-8 → FROM maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17
Update runtime stage: FROM eclipse-temurin:8-jre → FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre
Update JAR filename if version changed during upgrades
Remove TECH DEBT comment from Dockerfile
tasks.successCriteria: Docker image builds successfully with Java 17 base images. Container starts and runs the application.

tasks.title: Validate Full Build After Framework Upgrades
tasks.description: Run a full Maven build (mvn clean package) to validate that all Java 17 + Spring Boot 3.x changes compile successfully and all tests pass.
changes: Run mvn clean package to verify compilation
Run mvn test to verify all tests pass
Fix any compilation errors or test failures from the upgrade
tasks.successCriteria: mvn clean package succeeds with 0 errors and 0 test failures.

tasks.title: Validate Build After Messaging Migration
tasks.description: Run a full Maven build to validate that the RabbitMQ → Azure Service Bus migration compiles and tests pass.
changes: Run mvn clean package to verify messaging migration
Verify OrderMessageListener compiles with new Service Bus annotations
Validate application.yml configuration is correct
tasks.successCriteria: mvn clean package succeeds after messaging migration. No compilation errors.

tasks.title: CVE Vulnerability Check on Final Dependencies
tasks.description: Run a CVE vulnerability check on all final project dependencies to ensure no known security vulnerabilities exist after the modernization.
changes: Run CVE check on all Maven dependencies
Remediate any critical or high severity vulnerabilities
Document any accepted risks for lower severity issues
tasks.successCriteria: No critical or high severity CVEs in final dependency set.
